title: Random Gamemode 隨機切換模式
description: Randomly switches game modes every 30 seconds 每30秒隨機切換游戲模式
body:
這是我花了兩個小時半做出來的數據包。

🔴功能:

🎲 每 30 秒随机切换一次游戏模式

⚔️ 包含全部四种游戏模式：生存、创造、冒险以及旁观者

💬 切换时聊天栏显示提示，随时掌握当前模式

🔁 支持 /reload 重载，重载后显示安装成功提示

🪶 轻量化设计，不影响世界其他数据包运行

如果你想增加難度，建議不要在創造模式下複製和拿取物品！
歡迎拿去當作影片題材拍攝！如果願意也能在影片描述中放上數據包鏈接，方便更多人下載體驗！
在此致謝。

📦 安装方法

1：下载 random_gamemode.zip


2：打开你的 Minecraft 存档文件夹

3：將zip文件放入 datapacks/ 文件夹（不用解壓）

4：進入游戏后输入 /reload （會直接開始游戲）

看到提示即代表安装成功 ✅

🔴Function:

🎲 Randomly switch game modes every 30 seconds

⚔️ Includes all four game modes: Survival, Creative, Adventure and Spectator

💬 The chat bar displays prompts when switching, so you can keep track of the current mode at any time

🔁 Support /reload reloading, and a successful installation prompt will be displayed after reloading

🪶Lightweight design, does not affect the operation of other data packages in the world

If you want to increase the difficulty, it is recommended not to copy and take items in creative mode!
Welcome to use it as a film subject! If you like, you can also put a link to the data package in the video description so that more people can download and experience it!
Thanks for this.

📦 Installation method

1: Download random_gamemode.zip

2: Open your Minecraft save folder

3: Put the zip file into the datapacks/ folder (no need to unzip it)

4: Enter /reload after entering the game

When you see the prompt, it means the installation is successful ✅
